title: Floor Wang tiles — 5 terrain families + wall-shadow layer + procedural variant builders
intent: Per `docs/game-design/terrain-design.md §3` — refresh floor visuals via Wang autotile families. Five terrain types (grass / path / stone / dirt / floor), each registered as a separate Wang family with 16 procedural variants. Cells coexist with different families — sharp transitions handled by family-specific Wang variants (grass-edge meets path-edge cleanly). SECOND Wang layer: WallShadow — cells near hard blocks or cliffs get a darker overlay variant. Wall-shadow Wang composes ON TOP of base floor Wang. Plus optional per-cell sub-variant random pick for breaking obvious tiling within a single Wang index. Result: no two cells of the same family look identical; cliff-bases visibly shadow the floor; grass patches transition cleanly into path strips.
rationale: Source: user request 2026-05-28 + `terrain-design.md §3`. Depends on the Wang autotile engine module (GDP-2026-05-28-002 — pending in inbox). Pairs naturally with GDP-2026-05-28-010 (variable height) since shadow intensity scales with cliff height. This is the FLOOR visual fidelity push — bombers + blocks already got their visual layers (S102+S106 character mesh + accessories + textures, GDP-026-001 arena variants), but floor stays a single flat material. This story finishes the floor.
acceptanceHints: DEPENDS ON: GDP-2026-05-28-002 (Wang autotile engine module). Optional but recommended: GDP-2026-05-28-010 (variable height — wall-shadow intensity scales with cliff height).
READ FIRST: `docs/game-design/terrain-design.md §3` — canonical multi-family Wang spec + wall-shadow Wang layer design.
SCHEMA — examples/kaboom-crew/schemas/scene-extensions.schema.json:
FloorTerrain component { family: 'grass' | 'path' | 'stone' | 'dirt' | 'floor' }. Default 'floor' (current flat-plate variant — backwards compat).
WallShadow component { family: 'wall-shadow', intensity: number (0..1) }. Auto-computed at scene-load by WallShadowComputeSystem.
5 TERRAIN FAMILIES — register via Wang engine module from GDP-2026-05-28-002. Each family:
16 procedural variants (Wang index bitmask 0..15) — variant captures the appropriate edge detail (e.g. grass variant 1 = grass with east edge transitioning to non-grass).
Optional sub-variants per Wang index (Wang module gains sub-variant support per terrain-design.md §3.5). Deterministic per cell (gx, gz, sceneSeed) hash picks one. Breaks visible tiling.
FAMILY BUILDERS — each ~80-150 LOC procedural BufferGeometry generation:
buildGrassVariant(bitmask, subVariantIdx): green vertex-colour cell with subtle blade pattern (vertex-y noise). Edge variants tilt the blade pattern to face away from non-grass neighbours.
buildPathVariant(bitmask, subVariantIdx): brown packed-dirt with scattered stone dots (vertex colours). Edge variants have cleaner edges where path meets non-path.
buildStoneVariant(bitmask, subVariantIdx): grey laid-stone tile, mortar lines (panel-seam shader from GDP-027-007 reused). Edge variants align stone-row direction.
buildDirtVariant(bitmask, subVariantIdx): bare warm brown with subtle vertex-displacement ripples. Edge variants softer (dirt blends naturally).
buildFloorVariant(bitmask, subVariantIdx): flat plate with panel seams (current floor look). Edge variants have small overlap onto neighbours' floor (reads as 'tiled floor').
All builders produce vertex-coloured meshes — no textures, no UVs. Same approach as block-variants from GDP-2026-05-28-003.
WALL-SHADOW FAMILY (separate Wang family, registered alongside terrains):

buildWallShadowVariant(bitmask, subVariantIdx): semi-transparent dark overlay (alpha 0..0.5) shaped per bitmask. Variant 0 = fully transparent (no walls nearby). Variant 8 = darker stripe on N edge (wall to N). Variant 15 = full-cell darkening (surrounded by walls).
Shadow overlay renders ABOVE the base floor cell mesh (additive blending OR alpha overlay).
WALL-SHADOW COMPUTE SYSTEM (examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/wall-shadow-compute-system.ts):
Runs at scene load + on cell mesh changes (block destroyed, block spawned, height changed via GDP-2026-05-28-010).

For each floor cell: check 4 cardinals. If neighbour is a HardBlock OR has Height > self.height (cliff above) → tag cell as WallShadow with family='wall-shadow' AND intensity scaled by neighbour-block-height (taller cliff = darker).

Also check 8 surrounding cells (cardinal + diagonal) for 'partial shadow' (cells 1 step further from a wall get lighter overlay). This requires the WallShadow component to support a `distance: integer (0=adjacent, 1=one-away, 2=two-away)` field — variants then differ by distance.
Simpler v1 alternative: only 4-cardinal direct-adjacent walls cast shadow. Diagonal + further-away cells stay clear. Less accurate but cheaper.
WANG RESOLVER COMPOSITION:
Cell's floor mesh = base terrain Wang variant + optional wall-shadow Wang variant rendered on top.

Renderer treats wall-shadow as a SECOND child mesh entity per cell (Object3D parent → both meshes). Engine Wang resolver already supports re-resolution per family; just call it twice per cell (once for FloorTerrain, once for WallShadow).
PROJECT-SIDE WIRING:
examples/kaboom-crew/bootstrap.ts: register the 5 terrain families + the wall-shadow family via the Wang engine's registerWangTileFamily(). Pass each family's procedural builder.
Existing scene files default to FloorTerrain { family: 'floor' } — backwards compat, current arenas look like before.
Bench (examples/procbomber-bench): gains a 'Terrain family' dropdown — user can switch the procbomber preview floor to grass/path/stone/etc to see how variants tile.
PER-CELL SUB-VARIANT (optional, recommended polish):

Wang engine module from GDP-2026-05-28-002 ships with optional `variants: WangTileVariant[]|WangTileVariant[][]` field. This story populates that field — e.g. grass family has 3 sub-variants per Wang index = 48 distinct meshes per family.
hash(gx, gz, sceneSeed) % subVariants.length picks one. Same seed → same variant per cell.
Breaks the 'I can see the tile-grid' feel.
AUTHORING — heightmap-style terrain authoring:
Scene file gains optional `terrainmap?: ('grass'|'path'|'stone'|'dirt'|'floor')[][]`. 2D array matching arena dimensions. Default all 'floor' (backwards compat).
Combined with heightmap from GDP-2026-05-28-010, authors get complete terrain + height arena design surface.
PROTOTYPE ARENA (this story):

Update or create a scene `examples/kaboom-crew/scenes/grassland.scene.json` — 15×11 arena with terrainmap defining grass-and-path mix: a winding path strip across the centre + grass patches on sides + stone tiles around the spawn points + dirt patches near hard blocks.
Combined with WallShadow auto-tagging — hard blocks cast darker overlay on adjacent floor tiles.
Demonstrates the full visual variety of multi-terrain + wall-shadow + sub-variant variation.
ENGINE WANG MODULE EXTENSIONS NEEDED (in dependency story GDP-2026-05-28-002):
Sub-variant array support: variants typed as `WangTileVariant[] | WangTileVariant[][]`. Resolver picks variants[bitmask][hash % len] when arrays.
Multi-family-per-cell: a cell can have FloorTerrain + WallShadow components simultaneously. Resolver runs once per family present on the cell. Already implicit — Wang module is per-family.
MULTIPLAYER (per server-authoritative gameplay from S125):
Server resolves terrainmap + wall-shadow same as client. Visual layer is purely client-rendered, but for snapshot consistency, terrainmap is part of scene-load payload (sent once on joinWorld).
WallShadow recompute fires on cliff/block events — both server + client recompute. Visual divergence between tabs OK (cosmetic only).
DETERMINISM: variant + sub-variant selection deterministic by cell + sceneSeed. Same scene reload = same floor look.

PERFORMANCE: full resolve at scene-load: ~5 families × ~200 cells × O(1) variant lookup = ~1ms. Steady-state: no per-frame work. Mesh count grows ~2× per cell (base + shadow overlay) on shadowed cells; ~1× on non-shadowed. Within budget.
TESTS:
All 5 family builders produce 16 procedural meshes each. Unit tests assert distinct vertex counts / colors per bitmask.
Wall-shadow compute: floor cell next to hard block → WallShadow component written; intensity matches block height.
Scene reload: same scene → same per-cell variant pick (deterministic).
Grass cell next to path cell: grass picks variant with east-edge non-grass; path picks variant with west-edge non-path; meet cleanly at boundary.
Backwards compat: scene without terrainmap → all cells default to 'floor' family → current visual preserved.
VISUAL QA (manual):
Grassland prototype arena renders 5 visible terrain types (grass / path / stone / dirt / floor variants).
Cells next to hard blocks visibly darker on the wall-facing edge.
Two consecutive grass cells (interior, surrounded) use DIFFERENT sub-variants — no visible repeat.
Path edges look clean against grass (no awkward Z-fighting or seam artifacts).
OUT OF SCOPE:
Inter-family BLENDED transitions (grass fades into path). Sharp transitions only.
Animated floor tiles (rippling water, flowing lava). Static.
Floor that affects gameplay (slip on ice, slow on mud). All terrain is cosmetic.
Floor reaction to bombs (scorch marks, dent). Stays uniform.
Player-paintable terrain in-game. Authored only.
More than 5 starter families. Future polish.
